current_suggestion.pitch: Tim Urban is the author of Wait But Why and one of the clearest long-form thinkers alive on topics you care about — mental models, AI capabilities (his 'AI Revolution' posts remain foundational), and how humans reason under uncertainty. His visual essay format is distinct from anything in your current lineup: slow, methodical, often funny, and built around first-principles frameworks rather than expert interviews. His work on procrastination, social hierarchies, and the 'Elon' book research covers the 'inner game' and decision-making angle from a direction Huberman and Fridman don't touch.
